source: JDA survey drawing (DWG converted to DXF); no dimension entities present

dimensions.used_for: lane count, approach capacity, v/c, design life, queue length
dimensions.method: perpendicular transects every 5 m, median within 400 m of the junction; total kerb-to-kerb less the median, halved
dimensions.uncertainty: 95% bootstrap interval 0.5 to 7.0 m wide across the six junctions
dimensions.resolved_by: total station cross-sections at each junction and mid-block

dimensions.method: 5 m, chosen where the answer stops moving
dimensions.uncertainty: convergence tested at 25, 10, 5, 2 m; junctions converged: 6 of 6
dimensions.resolved_by: not applicable - this is a property of the method, not the road

dimensions.used_for: junction ordering, U-turn detours, pier siting stations
dimensions.method: cumulative distance along JDA's KML centreline in EPSG:32643
dimensions.uncertainty: the KML carries 14 vertices over 4,625 m, so curvature between vertices is cut off; the polyline is a lower bound on true length
dimensions.resolved_by: a surveyed centreline string, or the CAD alignment once its layer is identified

dimensions.used_for: the assumption that chainage and transects share one geometry
dimensions.method: distance from each centreline station to the nearest CAD linework
dimensions.uncertainty: median 1.36 m to the nearest divider line, 90th percentile 3.92 m
dimensions.resolved_by: a common control point in both, or a stated CAD georeference

dimensions.used_for: U-turn detour distances, and which bay reaches which opening
dimensions.method: centre of the gap between adjacent median runs, projected onto the alignment
dimensions.uncertainty: 0.4 m between the two chainage conventions, measured by running the corridor from each end. It was up to 33 m until openings were reported at their centre rather than at whichever edge the walk reached first
dimensions.resolved_by: total station at each opening: nose to nose, both medians

dimensions.used_for: whether a U-turn is physically possible at an opening
dimensions.method: gap between consecutive DIVIDER runs, measured along the alignment
dimensions.uncertainty: not quantified per opening - the DIVIDER layer is a single polyline set with no separate edge, so an opening's width has no second reading to compare against
dimensions.resolved_by: total station at each opening: nose to nose, and the receiving carriageway width opposite

dimensions.method: junction chainage to the nearest U-turn-capable opening, doubled
dimensions.uncertainty: carries the chainage uncertainty above, doubled; and 3 of 12 bays lie beyond the drawing so their detour is not measured at all rather than estimated
dimensions.resolved_by: the seven proposed bay chainages from JDA

dimensions.method: perpendicular distance from the alignment to each constraint feature
dimensions.uncertainty: inherits the registration figure above; feature positions are CAD vertices with no stated survey accuracy
dimensions.resolved_by: the drawing's own survey control sheet, if one exists

status: provisional: every dimension is scaled from georeferenced linework and a total station survey is required before design
